name: What is the typical process for improving indoor air quality with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for improving indoor air quality with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation and assessment to identify specific air quality issues. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal outlining recommended improvements, such as enhanced ventilation or moisture control. Once approved, our team schedules and executes the work, ensuring minimal disruption. This ensures a clear understanding of the project scope and timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, assessment, a detailed proposal for improvements, and then scheduling and executing the work.
